name: Teàrlag
source:
Rage and death. That was the entirety of their presence in the Weave; I've never felt anything like it. [url=https://vndb.org/c146903]Luther[/url] found orran-sized boot tread out on the grounds. He suspects it was a mercenary hired to surveil the manor for any sign of 'The Daemon' (aka [url=https://vndb.org/c146898]me[/url]).

Knew it the moment she walked through the doors at the ball: Teàrlag is the presence I felt outside the manor that night.

She was hired by [url=https://vndb.org/c170479]Aldus Colter[/url] for security, but was immediately attacked by [url=https://vndb.org/c170475]Mòr[/url]. The two rampaged across the grounds until [url=https://vndb.org/c146899]Cymhen[/url] stepped in.

Teàrlag is apparently Mòr's daughter. By birth, at any rate. Teàrlag was exiled and blacklisted after she accidentally killed her brother, the last Orran male with the Affinity, in a duel.

[In game description]
